# 6-Day Lisbon Visual Itinerary

A balanced Lisbon plan for **2 adults** with history, food, one beach day, and a **low-walking Day 4**. I’ve kept each day grouped by neighborhood so you can move efficiently and stay within a **€240/day food budget**.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Timeline

Day 1: Baixa + Alfama history start
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Praça do Comércio, Rua Augusta Arch, and a slow walk through Baixa’s grid streets
- Afternoon: Lisbon Cathedral, Miradouro de Santa Luzia, and Alfama lanes for classic old-town views
- Evening: Fado dinner in Alfama; keep it relaxed and close to your hotel
- Food budget: **€70–€120** for 2 adults
- Best for: first-day orientation, historic center, scenic viewpoints
Action: [Button: Open map](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Baixa+Alfama+Lisbon)

Day 2: Belém monuments + pastries
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Morning: Jerónimos Monastery, Belém Tower exterior, and Monument to the Discoveries
- Afternoon: Pastéis de Belém tasting, riverside stroll, and MAAT exterior if you want a modern contrast
- Evening: Riverfront seafood dinner back in central Lisbon
- Food budget: **€80–€140** for 2 adults
- Best for: major landmarks, iconic sweets, easy river scenery
Action: [Button: Open map](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Belem+Lisbon)

Day 3: Chiado + Bairro Alto food and culture
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/music-note.svg
- Morning: Chiado cafés, Livraria Bertrand area, and a slow start with brunch
- Afternoon: Santa Justa viewpoint, Carmo Convent, and a short browse through local shops
- Evening: Bairro Alto tapas or petiscos crawl, then optional sunset drinks
- Food budget: **€90–€160** for 2 adults
- Best for: food, atmosphere, compact sightseeing
Action: [Button: Open map](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Chiado+Bairro+Alto+Lisbon)

Day 4: Low-walking riverfront day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Tram or taxi to Parque das Nações for flat, easy movement along the waterfront
- Afternoon: Oceanário area, cable car ride, or a seated café break by the river
- Evening: Early dinner in the same area or return by taxi for a quiet night
- Food budget: **€75–€130** for 2 adults
- Best for: minimal walking, modern Lisbon, recovery day
Action: [Button: Open map](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Parque+das+Nacoes+Lisbon)

Day 5: Beach day in Cascais
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Train to Cascais and settle near the promenade or a beach club
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=Morning: Train to Cascais and settle near the promenade or a beach club, Lisbon, Portugal
- Afternoon: Praia da Rainha or nearby beaches, long lunch, and time by the water
- Evening: Sunset in Cascais, then return to Lisbon after dinner or stay local
- Food budget: **€100–€180** for 2 adults
- Best for: your one beach day, relaxed pace, coastal scenery
Action: [Button: Open map](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Cascais+Portugal)

Day 6: LX Factory + final food stops
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: LX Factory for design shops, coffee, and a final laid-back neighborhood feel
- Afternoon: Time for souvenirs, a late lunch, or a last viewpoint if energy is good
- Evening: Farewell dinner in Cais do Sodré or downtown, then pack and unwind
- Food budget: **€85–€150** for 2 adults
- Best for: shopping, casual dining, easy closing day
Action: [Button: Open map](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=LX+Factory+Lisbon)

## Neighborhood Map for Activity Grouping

- **Baixa**: arrival day, central squares, easy walking, classic Lisbon layout
- **Alfama**: history, viewpoints, Fado, narrow lanes
- **Belém**: monuments, museums, pastries, riverfront
- **Chiado**: cafés, bookstores, shopping, daytime culture
- **Bairro Alto**: evening dining, bars, nightlife
- **Parque das Nações**: low-walking day, waterfront, modern sights
- **Cais do Sodré**: food, nightlife, transport hub
- **Cascais**: beach day, promenade, seaside dining
- **LX Factory**: design shops, casual lunch, creative district

## Food Budget Plan for 2 Adults

- Target per day: **€240 max**
- Comfortable spend range: **€70–€180/day**
- Suggested split:
  - Breakfast: **€20–€35**
  - Lunch: **€35–€60**
  - Dinner: **€45–€90**
  - Snacks/coffee/drinks: **€10–€25**
- Highest-spend days: **Day 3, Day 5**
- Lowest-spend day: **Day 4**

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Build a route](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Lisbon&destination=Lisbon&travelmode=transit)

- Lisbon tourism overview: https://www.visitlisboa.com/
- Cascais visitor info: https://www.visitcascais.com/
- Lisbon public transport and rail connections: https://www.cp.pt/
